import.title: Import
import.lede: Bring in service cases, technicians or places from a file. You match its columns once and the app remembers.

import.file.known: You have imported a file with these columns before. The saved matching will be used.

import.values.help: Your file uses its own words. Match each one once; the app remembers them for the next file.

import.values.priority.help: Match each priority word to a priority level. One you do not match counts as the lowest level.
